title: urtica dioica var. hispidula
intro: Urtica dioica var. hispidula, commonly known as stinging nettle, is a variety of nettle plant native to Europe and Asia, known for its distinctive stinging hairs. This plant has been used for centuries in herbal medicine to provide various health benefits, including relieving symptoms of arthritis, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of stinging nettle include anti-inflammatory, diuretic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as urinary tract infections and skin conditions like eczema. The bioactive constituents of stinging nettle include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have potential health benefits when consumed as a dietary supplement.
